name: Repositories
description: Bar menu of every git repository under one directory (dots.repos): branch, ahead/behind the upstream, changed paths, unmerged branches and worktrees, checked when the menu opens, or when the pointer rests on the pill (which then grows to show an overview: how many repositories are up to date, need pulling or pushing, and so on). A row opens to its branches and worktrees and the actions: fetch, open the directory, a terminal there, VS Code there, delete a merged branch, remove a clean worktree. Commands come from the plugin settings (dots: modules/home/dank/repos-menu.nix).
author: dots
